description:
## v1.2.1 — fixes the startup crash (black screen) of v1.2.0

**v1.2.0 crashed every patched app at startup** (black screen, then the app closes): its signature-spoof extension was compiled against hand-written Android stubs that modeled several framework types with the wrong shape - `android.util.Base64` as a Kotlin object (the dex called a nonexistent `Base64.INSTANCE` field and an instance `decode` method) and `PackageInfo`'s public fields as Kotlin properties (nonexistent `getPackageName()`/`getSignatures()`/`getSigningInfo()` calls). On a device those references throw `NoSuchFieldError`/`NoSuchMethodError` inside the hook's static initializer, which kills the app before any UI.

v1.2.1 compiles the extension against the **real Android framework** (Robolectric's `android-all` build of AOSP) and adds `tools/AuditExtDex.java`, a build-time guard that mechanically verifies every `android/*` reference in the extension dex against the real framework - the exact class of bug above can no longer ship.

### Also in this release
- **Disable analytics & tracking** (new): rewrites 81 tracker endpoint constants on stable/beta (Firebase Analytics `app-measurement.com`, Google Ads/Doubleclick/IMA, `pagead2.googlesyndication.com`, Leanplum's `Constants.API_HOST_NAME` static field) and 8 on GX to a dead host. Firebase infrastructure that features depend on (push notifications, feature flags, GX's internal filter list) is deliberately untouched.
- Tightened fingerprint checks: *Disable ad modules* and *Remove sponsored Speed Dial* now fail loudly when ANY expected constant is missing, not just when all of them are.
- **Signing key rotated** (the old private key was lost with a recycled build environment). If you pinned the old `morphe-signing.pub`, remove and re-add this patch source once.
- Verified headlessly with Morphe Desktop CLI v2.1.1 on all three inputs: every patch applies; the 84 MB `libopera.so` stays byte-identical, uncompressed and 16 KiB-aligned; only the manifest, merged resource table, patched dex files and two whitelist assets differ from the input; the patched SQL parses; the output verifies with apksig (v2).
- Corrected the docs: the Chromium engine is bundled INSIDE the APK (84 MB 32-bit `libopera.so` + a decoy in `arm64-v8a`), not downloaded at first run as v1.2.0's notes claimed.

### Import
Add as patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=maniesh-NR/Vogelkop-MorphePatches
